meta.title: Approved-Intake Outcomes: refused for a user without the Requester / End User role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Requester / End User role and exercise Approved-Intake Outcomes to create an approved PR, ticket, material request, or vendor request, observing whether Procol refuses or omits the action.
Repeat the same Approved-Intake Outcomes action as a Requester / End User and compare availability against the other role.
Verify the tenant is on the Growth plan and inspect whether tenant RBAC configuration deliberately grants the action to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Requester / End User role and exercise Approved-Intake Outcomes to create an approved PR, ticket, material request, or vendor request, observing whether Procol refuses or omits the action.; Repeat the same Approved-Intake Outcomes action as a Requester / End User and compare availability against the other role.; Verify the tenant is on the Growth plan and inspect whether tenant RBAC configuration deliberately grants the action to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as both the user without the Requester / End User role and a Requester / End User on the same Growth tenant, run Approved-Intake Outcomes for an approved intake, and record whether PR, ticket, material request, or vendor request creation is refused, absent, or available for each role

steps.note: The catalog cannot sign in as role-specific users, reach Approved-Intake Outcomes, or inspect the tenant's RBAC configuration.
Confirm the session remains usable after the tester completes the role comparison; this does not assert the access-control outcome.
